package.description: A new lightweight, hybrid routing mesh protocol for packet radios

en-US.description: A new lightweight, hybrid routing mesh protocol for packet radios
en-US.longDescription: MeshCore is a lightweight, portable C++ library that enables multi-hop packet routing for embedded projects using LoRa and other packet radios. It is designed for developers who want to create resilient, decentralized communication networks that work without the internet.
en-US.name: MeshCore
